steps.text: The sea bakes the registered real shores once into a coast texture: the real bed for swimming and the foam lip, and a drawn shelf that falls away from the coast for the colour.
One baked caustic tile, sampled twice as it scrolls, lights the sand and rocks under the shallows.
The sea is one blended plane coloured by depth, with two scrolling layers of our own wave cell for the sparkle and one depth copy for foam where it meets things. Neutral finishes the image.
